description: Retired Air India Airbus A319 bought at auction in 2023, converted and opened as the Brownstone Air Dine restaurant at the end of 2025, still in Air India livery beside the Pune-Satara highway (Indian Express 21 Mar 2026, NDTV Food, Curly Tales). Registration not published - needs reading on site. Coordinates approximate (Khed Shivapur).
